title: Off-stage objects not visible or selectable — no editable pasteboard work area around the stage
description:
FIXED (task 1273). ROOT CAUSE: render <canvas> + grid canvas + CanvasRenderer backing buffer were sized to EXACTLY stageW×H at top:0/left:0, so any object/halo drawn at off-stage coords (x<0/y<0/x>W/y>H) landed at a canvas pixel outside the bitmap and was clipped by the canvas's own dimensions (invisible; selection halos invisible too). Hit-test math was never stage-clamped, so visibility was the sole blocker.

FIX (packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx, render/hit-test region only — eraser-handler region untouched, no renderer.ts change): computePasteboardMargin(stageW,stageH)=clamp(0.6*max,[220,900]); enlarge the render canvas + CanvasRenderer backing buffer to stage+margin on every side (canvasWidth/canvasHeight) and position the render canvas at top/left=-margin so the stage box still aligns at (0,0). Scene content offset via viewport={x:-margin,y:-margin,zoom:1} (renderer already does translate(-viewport.x,-viewport.y)); all direct halo/handle/preview/motion-path draws get the same offset via one ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,margin*dpr,margin*dpr) base translate applied after render() and before the overlay blocks (they only save/restore so it persists). Onion/parent-edit branches clear/draw/composite at canvasWidth/canvasHeight. Grid canvas stays stage-sized (grid is a stage-only guide). Gray pasteboard + white stage rect + edge shadow remain the visual boundary on top. toStageCoords was already unclamped so off-stage content is now both visible AND selectable/draggable.

TEST: packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/offStagePasteboard.test.ts (7 tests).

VERIFY (worktree agent-a8b27ac6593def15f): build all 7 packages Done; authoring-ui 48 files/684 tests PASS (incl new 7); swf 115/1446 PASS; core 332/335 — the only 3 fails are pre-existing ENOENT on untracked binary fixtures (fixtures/flash8-empty.fla; carchive-validate/contents-structure/empty-bytematch), unrelated to this change.
